First of all, we see immediately from it that the sign of a joint cumulant of spins is prescribed, which was \emph{a priori} non-obvious. On the other hand, applying Theorem \ref{thm:jointcumulant} to the case $r=1$ yields $$\kappa(\sigma(i),\sigma(j))=x^{|j-i|},$$ that is, the correlation between two spins decreases exponentially with the distance between the spins.
